title: Cancelled Shonen Jump Series Unveils New Update Ahead of Anime Debut
content: Almost a decade later, a forgotten Shonen Jump classic will be returning with its anime revival this year. The Black Torch manga by Tsuyoshi Takaki was serialized in the Jump SQ magazine of Shueisha from 2016 to 2018.
author: ComicBook

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Unveils New Home Video Update
content: Following the explosive success of the first installment of the Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle trilogy, the anime is preparing the upcoming two films before adapting the final arc. Infinity Castle is the second-to-final arc of the series that features the epic showdown between the Demon Slayers and the Upper Moons.
author: ComicBook

title: Cyborg 009: Nemesis Anime Casts Yūki Kaji as Joe Shimamura
content: The staff also unveiled the below visual for the Nemesis group of characters in the anime. The anime's website has also announced a new main cast member for the Nemesis group every week in the past two months.
author: ANN

title: The Days of Diamond Manga Returns in June
content: This year's 24th issue of Shueisha 's Young Jump magazine announced on Thursday that Ōhashi Hirai 's The Days of Diamond ( Diamond no Kōzai ) manga will resume serialization in the 27th issue on June 4. The series entered a hiatus on January 22. The series recently returned from hiatus on September 18.
author: ANN

title: Yuu Yoshinaga Launches New Series
content: The June issue of Shogakukan 's Betsucomi magazine announced on Wednesday Yuu Yoshinaga will debut a new series titled Saredo, Futari wa Kusare En (Even So, We Have an Undesirable, Yet Inseparable Love) in the magazine's next issue on June 12.
author: ANN

title: Sekai Project to Release Neko-Mimi Sweet Housemates 2, Neko-Nin exHeart Spin! 2 Visual Novels in West
content: Sekai Project announced during its panel at Anime Central on Friday that it has licensed Animal Herb's Neko-Mimi Sweet Housemates 2 ( Uchi no Pet Jijou 2 ) and Whirlpool's Neko-Nin exHeart Spin! 2 visual novels for release in the West in 2026.
author: ANN

title: Yen Press Licenses Moscow 2160, Love at the City's Edge on a Moonlit Night, Terrarium in a Drawer, 14 More Manga/Novels
content: Yen Press announced on Friday that it has licensed 11 manga and seven novel series for release in November. The company also revealed that it will release an audiobook for Keiichi Hikami 's Elden Ring - themed novel See You at That Site of Grace After Work in November.
author: ANN

title: Motoka Murakami Draws New 1-Shot for Musashi no Ken Manga After 40 Years
content: Motoka Murakami revealed on his X/Twitter account on Tuesday that he is publishing a new one-shot story for his Musashi no Ken manga, more than 40 years since it ended in 1985. The one-shot will debut on Shogakukan 's Sunday Webry manga service on May 20.
author: ANN
